verdict.text: 2 problems App Review or App Store Connect turns away, and 2 warnings to review

findings.title: Purpose string missing
findings.message: The expo-tracking-transparency package (its config plugin is not in expo.plugins) needs NSUserTrackingUsageDescription (App Tracking Transparency); field-notes has none.

fix.title: Set the text in app.json
steps: Set the key under expo.ios.infoPlist in app.json, or pass the text to the package's config plugin option, with a sentence that says what the app does with the data.
Run npx expo prebuild --clean (or the next EAS Build) so the native Info.plist gets it.

sources.title: Apple: Requesting access to protected resources

findings.title: Xcode older than App Store Connect accepts
findings.message: eas.json pins Xcode 16.4 (EAS image); App Store Connect accepts uploads built with Xcode 26 or later since 28 April 2026.

fix.title: Build with Xcode 26 or later
steps: Change the pinned version to Xcode 26 or later (for example 27.1) in the file and line the finding names, and use a runner or build image that has it.
Fix the build warnings and errors the newer SDK reports before the next upload.

sources.title: Apple Developer News: Upcoming SDK minimum requirements (3 February 2026)

findings.title: Purpose string is placeholder or default text
findings.message: The expo-location config plugin writes its default text for NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription, NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription, NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: no option or ios.infoPlist value gives the app's own.

fix.title: Pass your own text to the config plugin
steps: Add the plugin to expo.plugins with its permission option, for example ["expo-camera", { "cameraPermission": "Scan a receipt to add it to your expenses." }], or set the key under expo.ios.infoPlist.
Set the option to false instead if the app never uses that permission: the plugin then leaves the key out.

sources.title: Apple: Adhere to the requirements for purpose strings

findings.title: No privacy manifest
findings.message: app.json has no ios.privacyManifests, so prebuild writes no privacy manifest for the app.

fix.title: Add ios.privacyManifests to app.json
steps: Add expo.ios.privacyManifests with NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes (and the data types the app collects); prebuild writes them into PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.

sources.title: Apple: Describing use of required reason API

checks.title: Purpose string missing for a package feature
Purpose string is placeholder or default text
Third-party login without an equivalent option
